Package net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.addon

Annotation Interface CozyVoiceAddon

@Documented @Retention(RUNTIME) @Target(TYPE) public @interface CozyVoiceAddon
Marks a class as a Cozy Voice Chat addon entry point, so the mod finds it automatically.

The annotated class must:

  • implement CozyVoicePlugin;
  • be a public, non-abstract top-level (or static nested) class;
  • have a public no-argument constructor;
  • live in a Forge mod jar (it is found through Forge's annotation scan data of all loaded mod files, ModList.get().getAllScanData()).

During FMLCommonSetupEvent (on the main thread, through enqueueWork) Cozy Voice Chat scans every mod file for this annotation, creates one instance of each class, calls CozyVoicePlugin.onRegister(net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.CozyVoiceApi) and logs the list of addons. Registered addons are listed by /cozyvoice addons and by CozyVoiceApi.getAddons().


 @CozyVoiceAddon
 public final class MyVoiceAddon implements CozyVoicePlugin {
     @Override
     public String getId() {
         return "myaddon";
     }

     @Override
     public void onRegister(CozyVoiceApi api) {
         MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS.register(MyVoiceEvents.class);
     }
 }

The class is only loaded when Cozy Voice Chat is installed, so it is a safe place for API calls in an addon that has Cozy Voice Chat as an optional dependency.

Using the annotation is optional: addons can still just call CozyVoiceApi.get() and subscribe to events; they are simply not listed as addons then.
